layout.title: Editorial page (com_authors)
layout.message: Renders an editorial, trust or data page from com_authors: Responsible Gambling, Affiliate Disclosure, Privacy Policy, FEC Payout Index. Set the Page slug field below to a live topic slug, for example fast-payouts. Only topics with status live render.

field.name: slug
field.label: Page slug
field.description: Slug of the editorial page to render. Must match a live entry in the page topic registry. Examples: responsible-gambling, privacy-policy, fast-payouts.
